service.name: Beatles sing-along duo
service.serviceType: A Beatles sing-along for senior living, community events and private parties
service.description: Your Bird Can Sing is a two-person Beatles sing-along that hands out booklets with the words in them. It books as one duo across the Denver area, the Front Range and the mountain corridor.

faqs.q: What is Your Bird Can Sing?
faqs.a: Your Bird Can Sing is a two-person Beatles sing-along. The duo plays the songs and hands out booklets with the words in them, so the crowd can join in without knowing the verses by heart. It books as one duo.

faqs.q: Is this a Beatles tribute band?
faqs.a: No. Nobody wears a wig, nobody puts on an accent, and there's no stage show built around impersonating four people. The duo plays the catalogue and gets the crowd singing it.

faqs.q: Do the guests need to be able to sing?
faqs.a: No. The booklets carry the words and the duo carries the tune, so anyone who wants to join in can, and anyone who would rather sit and listen can do that instead.

faqs.q: Does it work for a crowd of mixed ages?
faqs.a: Yes, that's what it's built for. The Beatles catalogue is the songbook small children and great-grandparents already share, which is why the same booking works for a family party and for a senior living afternoon.

faqs.q: How much space and power does a duo need?
faqs.a: A duo sets up in about 8 by 6 feet on the floor and runs from one standard outlet. In a small lounge it plays without amplification, and in a common area it sits at 65 to 72 dBA, which is conversation level.
Yes, in a courtyard, a garden or a park, with shade over the musicians and one outlet within reach. Footprints, power and the weather cover are set out on the technical page.
